name: Wellness Club - GHL Event Logger & Reminder Scheduler

parameters.content:
## Wellness Club Backend

**Pattern:** GHL handles client journey, n8n handles backend reliability.

**This workflow:**
1. Receives GHL webhooks (any event)
2. Normalizes event schema
3. Idempotency check (handles GHL retries)
4. Routes by event type
5. Logs to appropriate sheet
6. Triggers tiered reminders for new appointments

**Sheets used:** Bookings_Log, Leads_Log, KPIs, Errors
